_provenance.method: anonymous ContentPackages -> Artifacts, Type-only select, tallied per package Products tag
_provenance.note: COUNTS ONLY, BY PACKAGE PRODUCT TAG. Walks the same anonymous ContentPackages -> Artifacts route as api-hub-catalog.json but keeps tallies rather than rows: ~13,000 CDS views and BAdIs would dominate the repository for content nothing probes. A floor for the same reason the API harvest is one — it counts artifacts that belong to a package. NOT evidence that any of it is active on a tenant.
